notes: Datasat's own domain (datasat.com) now resolves to an unrelated, expired-domain placeholder (TLS cert for a2zcarsales.co.uk), and the live manufacturer site datasatdigital.com sits behind a Cloudflare bot challenge that blocked direct fetch tools. Specs were retrieved via a text-extraction proxy of https://datasatdigital.com/products/ap20/ (Datasat's current AP20 product page), cross-checked across two independent fetches with consistent, self-coherent detail (parent company Amplifier Technologies Inc./Theta Digital/BGW, Dirac Live licensing, etc. match known facts about Datasat), giving reasonable confidence in the content, but I could not visually confirm rear-panel silkscreen port labels or exact power-inlet connector type, and several ports use DB25 D-sub connectors that have no exact match in the allowed connector enum (mapped to the closest protocol/analog id: aes3 for AES/EBU DB25 breakouts, trs-6.35 for balanced-analog DB25 breakouts, euroblock for the GPIO DB25). HDMI is spec'd as HDMI 1.3, which is below the lowest available grade option (hdmi-1.4), so grade was omitted on all 5 HDMI ports rather than overstate bandwidth. AC inlet connector type (assumed IEC C13/C14) was not explicitly stated in the source. An 8-channel reduced-I/O variant of the AP20 also exists per the datasheet notes but was not itemized separately.

ports.name: AES/EBU Digital In A (DB25, ch 1-8)
ports.note: Physically a female DB25 D-sub carrying 8 channels of AES/EBU digital audio (2 DB25 connectors = 16 ch total); DB25 isn't in the allowed connector list so the AES3 protocol id was used as the closest match.

ports.name: AES/EBU Digital In B (DB25, ch 9-16)
ports.note: Second female DB25 D-sub, channels 9-16 of the 16-channel AES/EBU digital input.

ports.name: HDMI In 1
ports.note: Spec states HDMI 1.3 compliant, which is below the lowest gradeable option (hdmi-1.4) so grade was omitted rather than overstate bandwidth.

ports.name: HDMI In 2
ports.note: HDMI 1.3 compliant; grade omitted (below hdmi-1.4 floor).

ports.name: HDMI In 3
ports.note: HDMI 1.3 compliant; grade omitted (below hdmi-1.4 floor).

ports.name: HDMI In 4
ports.note: HDMI 1.3 compliant; grade omitted (below hdmi-1.4 floor).

ports.name: HDMI Out (video pass-through)
ports.note: 5th HDMI connector, switchable to output with video pass-through; HDMI 1.3 compliant, grade omitted (below hdmi-1.4 floor).

ports.name: Analog Audio In (DB25, 8 balanced ch)
ports.note: Physically a female DB25 D-sub carrying 8 balanced analog channels (10k ohm, 300mV rms); DB25 not in the connector enum, so the balanced-analog id trs-6.35 was used as the closest match.

ports.name: Aux In L (RCA)
ports.note: One of 2 single-ended stereo aux/non-sync input pairs.

ports.name: Aux In R (RCA)
ports.note: One of 2 single-ended stereo aux/non-sync input pairs.

ports.name: Mic In
ports.note: Single female XLR mic input, switchable +48V phantom power.

ports.name: AES/EBU Digital Out A (DB25, ch 1-8)
ports.note: Male DB25 D-sub, 8 of 16 AES/EBU digital output channels; DB25 not in enum, aes3 used as closest match.

ports.name: AES/EBU Digital Out B (DB25, ch 9-16)
ports.note: Second male DB25 D-sub, remaining 8 of 16 AES/EBU digital output channels.

ports.name: Analog Audio Out A (DB25, ch 1-8)
ports.note: Male DB25 D-sub, 8 of 16 balanced analog output channels; DB25 not in enum, balanced-analog id used as closest match.

ports.name: Analog Audio Out B (DB25, ch 9-16)
ports.note: Second male DB25 D-sub, remaining 8 of 16 balanced analog output channels.

ports.name: Monitor Out (RCA)
ports.note: Single-ended, channel-selectable monitor output, adjustable level.

ports.name: Assistive Listening Out (RCA)
ports.note: Fixed-level (300mV rms) summed output for assistive listening systems.

ports.name: GPIO / Automation (DB25)
ports.note: Parallel contact-closure automation I/O on a DB25 D-sub; no exact multi-pin control connector exists in the enum, euroblock (terminal-block control connector) chosen as the closest control-I/O analog.

ports.name: AC Power In
ports.note: 100-240 VAC 50/60Hz auto-switching, 60W. Datasheet did not show a photo of the inlet; IEC C13/C14 assumed as the standard connector for this class of rack processor.
